Create a single EMPTY transparent clear-glass vase in fine ink and watercolour on genuine alpha transparency. Keep Input1 canvas 1400x2000 exactly and shape/placement. Axis x700, inner base y1800, open mouth y200, inner height1600. At y1800,1640,1480,1320,1160,1000,840,680,520,360,200 the INNER radii are 228.4,248.3,276.5,321.4,403.7,511,403.7,321.4,276.5,248.3,228.4 pixels. Draw a smooth curve through those points with no corners, including a smooth broadest belly at y1000. This unusually narrow-necked narrow-based barrel profile is intentional. Preserve exact silhouette proportions, symmetric about x700 and y1000. Paint thin10to14px glass walls OUTSIDE the inner guide, with delicate dark ink edge, pale highlights only.
